name: tracking-check
description: Checks a Google Tag Manager and GA4 setup against the tracking verification checklist. Read-only, no API key, no dependencies.

scripts.sample: node tracking-check.mjs --dir sample/site --container sample/gtm.js --gtm GTM-SAMPLE1 --mid G-SAMPLE0001 --record sample/records.md --out sample/report
